steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each procedure step must be in order and documented, and each decision needs a reason.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Step out of order
findings.fix: Re-run the step in the procedure's order

findings.title: Decision with no recorded reason
findings.fix: Record the reason before the decision stands

outcome.notChecked: Whether the facts support the decision.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] case-timing.md:12  Step out of order.
       Fix: Re-run the step in the procedure's order.
[high] case-decision.md:19  Decision with no recorded reason.
       Fix: Record the reason before the decision stands.
[medium] case-documents.md:26  Step missing from the documentation.
       Fix: Add the documentation.
Not checked: Whether the facts support the decision.
pros: Checks a step missing, a step out of order, and a decision with no recorded reason.
cons: Not checked: Whether the facts support the decision.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-disciplinary-process-check skill on the records for this review.
